## How these numbers were produced

`scripts/record-tour.sh` logs a wall clock reading inside its own `beat` function, against a
`T0` pinned the moment `screenrecord`'s output file first had bytes in it. Each row below is
therefore an **observed** elapsed second, accurate to the polling interval (50 ms) plus one
frame -- not a model of the choreography scaled to fit the duration, which is what the
2026-08-22 map was, and what it cost that session a section of its changelog to admit.

`Untested:` the residual offset between `screenrecord`'s own frame zero and the first byte
reaching the file. It is bounded by one frame at the capture rate and has not been measured
directly. Spot-check three rows by extracting that exact frame and looking at it before
cutting on a single frame.
